title: On $C^k$-functions mapping $\mathbb{Q}$ into itself and Mahler's problem on Liouville numbers
summary: Liouville numbers form a classical class of transcendental real numbers characterized by exceptionally strong rational approximations. A theorem of Maillet shows that non-constant rational functions with rational coefficients preserve the Liouville property, motivating a question of Mahler on whether analogous phenomena hold for transcendental functions. In this paper, we address this problem for real functions of finite smoothness.
